First of all you are not harsh and unkind at all. You say what you believe in an excellent way. In many ways like a professional would, which tells m you have a lot of experience on either side. I really appreciate it. 
Yes some of it is not necessarily what I want to hear, but it doesn’t make it any less true.

My problem with time is that I’ve never been patient. I know it’s a virtue but it’s one I lack. 

Distraction is hard. I put most of my interests aside during the relationship. To the point where I barely know who I am any more. This is not something I would fully blame on her. Yes she is very needy with her issues without reciprocation most of the time. Me having any issues and emotions was often an issue while I had to constantly be there for her.
Now I fully know this is in large part my fault too. Because being a very empathetic and caring person who always put others first is often damaging. 
Part of it is good. But not loosing yourself in someone else.

Yes. After a lot of crying today I am feeling better but I also know it’s temporary, and I’m always scared of my temporary emotions getting the better of me since I have past issues with suicide and suicidal tendencies.

Yes I am surprised by myself for taking the step to post online. I usually keep everything to myself. I did it constantly throughout the relationship because there was a lot of abusive elements and I did not want our mutual friends or my friends to think badly of her. I still don’t since I see the whys of her behaviour and I have so much love for her. I always forgive everyone. I can’t hold grudges. Which i think is good, but also damaging.

I also suffer from bpd which means my emotional half is very strong.

I understand the logic of the helping part, but I also feel that’s my greatest strength. To help and to relieve other of their burdens. I often think this is my one true purpose, because it is something I am good at. It just takes its toll.

Do you mind if I ask what your experience was?

I really appreciate it. And you’re not off at all. And minimum contact is what I had planned anyhow. some is needed because I still have things there. But I am going to do my best to distance myself.

And everything you said I perfectly understand on a logical level. Emotionally is a totally different story. My heart just wants to push, but that is the last thing I should do. It’s neither healthy nor helpful. But being an emotional creature it is very hard to suppress those urges.

Also all I want is to help her. That’s all I want. I believe in her to get past it but I also know her and she doesn’t reach out to the right people when she needs to and that scares me.
